description: This Java class 'FromJsonHelper' provides utility methods for parsing, extracting, and validating JSON data within the Apache Fineract project. It facilitates conversion between JSON and Java objects, supports parameter validation, and offers helpers for extracting various data types from JSON inputs.

classes.name: FromJsonHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing methods for JSON parsing, validation, and extraction tailored for the Fineract project.

methods.name: extractMap
methods.description: Parses JSON into a Map with String keys and Boolean values.

methods.name: extractDataMap
methods.description: Parses JSON into a Map with String keys and String values.

methods.name: extractObjectMap
methods.description: Parses JSON into a Map with String keys and Object values.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes JSON string into an object of the specified class.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes a JsonElement or Object into its JSON string representation.

methods.name: checkForUnsupportedParameters
methods.description: Validates JSON input against a set of supported parameters, throws exception if unsupported params are found.

methods.name: checkForUnsupportedParameters
methods.description: Overloaded method that validates a JsonObject directly.

methods.name: checkForUnsupportedNestedParameters
methods.description: Validates nested JSON parameters, annotating unsupported parameters with their full path.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a JsonElement, returns null if input is blank.

methods.name: parameterExists
methods.description: Checks if a parameter exists in a JsonElement.

methods.name: parameterHasValue
methods.description: Checks if a parameter has a non-blank value.

methods.name: extractStringNamed
methods.description: Extracts a String parameter by name from a JsonElement.

methods.name: extractLongNamed
methods.description: Extracts a Long parameter by name from a JsonElement.

methods.name: extractJsonArrayNamed
methods.description: Extracts a JsonArray parameter by name from a JsonElement.

methods.name: extractArrayNamed
methods.description: Extracts an array of Strings by name from JSON.

methods.name: extractBooleanNamed
methods.description: Extracts a Boolean parameter by name from a JsonElement.

methods.name: extractMonthDayNamed
methods.description: Extracts a MonthDay object by name from a JsonElement.

methods.name: extractLocalDateNamed
methods.description: Extracts a LocalDate by name from a JsonElement.

methods.name: extractLocalTimeNamed
methods.description: Extracts a LocalTime by name from a JsonElement.

methods.name: extractLocalDateTimeNamed
methods.description: Extracts a LocalDateTime by name from a JsonElement.

methods.name: extractBigDecimalWithLocaleNamed
methods.description: Extracts a BigDecimal considering locale from a JsonElement.

methods.name: extractIntegerWithLocaleNamed
methods.description: Extracts an Integer considering locale from a JsonElement.

methods.name: enumValueOfParameterNamed
methods.description: Converts a string parameter to an enum value, validating against allowed enum constants.
